haiku.problem: Uses "him" before Josiah is named ("before and after him"), breaking the rule against he/she/they/him before saying who it is.

The set leaves out Josiah's death at Megiddo, which the passage title names and which is one of its main events. The Prep cards on Neco and Megiddo (2-9, 2-11) and Jehoahaz's anointing (2-13) were available for it.
